name: PauliMatrix.pauliContrDown_mul_pauliContr_mul_pauliContrDown
proof:
lemma pauliContrDown_mul_pauliContr_mul_pauliContrDown : ({
    σ^^^ | μ τ(α) τ(β) ⊗ σ^^^ | ν α β' ⊗ σ^^^ | ρ τ(α') τ(β') =
      ((((η | μ ν ⊗ σ^^^ | ρ τ(α') τ(β))
        + (-((η | μ ρ ⊗ σ^^^ | ν τ(α') τ(β)))))
        + (η | ν ρ ⊗ σ^^^ | μ τ(α') τ(β)))
        + ((-Complex.I) •ₜ (ε4ℂ | μ ν ρ κ ⊗ σ^^^ | τ(κ) τ(α') τ(β))))
    }ᵀ : Prop) := by
  simp_rw [dualWeyl_mul_pauliContr_eq_ofGaussianInt]
  simp only [toTensor_dualWeyl_eq_ofGaussianInt, contrMetric_eq_ofGaussianInt,
    leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt_prod, toTensor_dualAll_eq_ofGaussianInt,
    prodT_ofGaussianInt_ofGaussianInt, contrT_ofGaussianInt, permT_ofGaussianInt]
  apply (Tensor.basis _).repr.injective
  ext1
  simp only [permT_basis_repr_symm_apply, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply,
    map_neg, Finsupp.neg_apply, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ofGaussianInt_basis_repr_apply]
  simp only [show Complex.I = GaussianInt.toComplex ⟨0, 1⟩ by
    simp [GaussianInt.toComplex_def'], ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_mul,
    ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_neg, ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_add]
  apply congrArg
  decide +revert +kernel

name: PauliMatrix.pauliContr_mul_pauliContrDown_mul_pauliContr
proof:
lemma pauliContr_mul_pauliContrDown_mul_pauliContr : ({
    σ^^^ | μ α β ⊗ σ^^^ | ν τ(α') τ(β) ⊗ σ^^^ | ρ α' β' =
      ((((η | μ ν ⊗ σ^^^ | ρ α β') + (-((η | μ ρ ⊗ σ^^^ | ν α β'))))
        + (η | ν ρ ⊗ σ^^^ | μ α β'))
        + (Complex.I •ₜ (ε4ℂ | μ ν ρ κ ⊗ σ^^^ | τ(κ) α β')))
    }ᵀ : Prop) := by
  simp_rw [pauliContr_mul_dualWeyl_eq_ofGaussianInt, leviCivita_mul_pauliDual]
  simp only [toTensor_eq_ofGaussianInt, contrMetric_eq_ofGaussianInt,
    leviCivita_eq_ofGaussianInt_prod, pauliCo_eq_ofGaussianInt,
    prodT_ofGaussianInt_ofGaussianInt, contrT_ofGaussianInt]
  apply (Tensor.basis _).repr.injective
  ext
  simp only [map_add, map_neg, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply,
    Finsupp.neg_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, permT_basis_repr_symm_apply]
  simp only [ofGaussianInt_basis_repr_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    show Complex.I = GaussianInt.toComplex ⟨0, 1⟩ by
      simp [GaussianInt.toComplex_def'], ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_add,
    ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_neg, ← GaussianInt.toComplex.map_mul]
  apply congrArg
  decide +revert +kernel

name: cauchyBinet
proof:
lemma cauchyBinet {m : ℕ} {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] [LinearOrder n]
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (A : Matrix (Fin m) n R) (B : Matrix n (Fin m) R) :
    (A * B).det = ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m},
      (A.submatrix id (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2)).det *
      (B.submatrix (S.1.orderEmbOfFin S.2) id).det := by
  have hd (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) :
      M.det = ∑ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m), (∏ i, M i (τ i)) * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : R) := by
    rw [← Matrix.det_transpose M, Matrix.det_apply']
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => mul_comm _ _
  have h_cauchy_binet : (A * B).det = ∑ σ : Fin m → n,
      (∏ i, A i (σ i)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j ↦ B (σ i) j)) := by
    simp only [hd, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
    simp only [prod_sum, sum_mul]
    refine' Finset.sum_bij (fun f _ i => f i (Finset.mem_univ _)) _ _ _ _
    · exact fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _
    · simp only [univ_pi_univ, mem_univ, funext_iff, forall_true_left, forall_const]
      exact fun _ _ h => h
    · simp only [mem_univ, univ_pi_univ, exists_const, forall_const]
      exact fun b => ⟨fun i _ => b i, rfl⟩
    · simp only [univ_pi_univ, mem_univ, prod_mul_distrib, prod_attach_univ, forall_const]
      intro a
      ac_rfl
  let f := fun σ : Fin m → n => (∏ i, A i (σ i)) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j ↦ B (σ i) j))
  rw [h_cauchy_binet]
  change (∑ σ, f σ) = _
  trans ∑ S : {S : Finset n // S.card = m}, ∑ σ,
    if Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val then f σ else 0
  · rw [← Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    by_cases hσ : Function.Injective σ
    · simp only [hσ, true_and]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨Finset.image σ Finset.univ, by
        simp only [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hσ, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]⟩]
      · exact (if_pos rfl).symm
      · intro T _ hT
        exact if_neg (fun h => hT (Subtype.ext h.symm))
      · simp only [mem_univ, not_true_eq_false, false_implies]
    · simp only [hσ, false_and, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]
      simp only [Function.Injective, not_forall] at hσ
      obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hne⟩ := hσ
      exact mul_eq_zero_of_right _ (Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq hne (by
        ext1
        simp only [of_apply, hij]))
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
    let e := S.val.orderEmbOfFin S.property
    have he : Finset.image e Finset.univ = S.val := by
      refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
        (Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr fun i _ => Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _) ?_
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ e.injective]
      simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, S.2, le_refl]
    have hf : Finset.filter (fun σ : Fin m → n => Function.Injective σ ∧ Finset.image σ Finset.univ = S.val) Finset.univ =
        Finset.image (fun τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m) => fun i => e (τ i)) Finset.univ := by
      ext σ
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
      constructor
      · intro hσ
        have h_exists_a : ∀ i, ∃ a : Fin m, σ i = e a := by
          intro i
          have hmem : σ i ∈ Finset.image e Finset.univ := by
            rw [he, ← hσ.2]
            exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
          obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hmem
          exact ⟨a, ha.symm⟩
        choose a ha using h_exists_a
        have ha_inj : Function.Injective a :=
          fun i j hij => hσ.1 <| by simp only [ha, hij]
        exact ⟨Equiv.ofBijective a ⟨ha_inj, Finite.injective_iff_surjective.mp ha_inj⟩,
          funext fun i => (ha i).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
        constructor
        · exact e.injective.comp a.injective
        · refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
            (Finset.image_subset_iff.mpr fun i _ => Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _) ?_
          rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (show Function.Injective (fun i => e (a i)) from e.injective.comp a.injective)]
          simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, S.2, le_refl]
    rw [← Finset.sum_filter, hf, Finset.sum_image]
    · rw [hd (A.submatrix id e), Finset.sum_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun τ _ => ?_
      change (∏ i, A i (e (τ i))) * ((B.submatrix e id).submatrix τ id).det = _
      rw [Matrix.det_permute]
      ac_rfl
    · exact fun τ _ τ' _ h => Equiv.Perm.ext fun i => e.injective (congr_fun h i)

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists ChoiceBisim, .choice h
  rintro _ _ (h | h) μ
  all_goals
    apply (Bisimilarity.isBisimulation _ _ h μ).imp
    all_goals
    intro f s t
  iterate 2
    cases t
    exact (f _ ‹_›).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL .bisim
    exact ⟨s, Tr.choiceR ‹_›, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
  all_goals exact (f _ t).imp fun _ => And.imp_right .bisim

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.preservation
proof:
lemma Typing.preservation (der : Typing Γ t τ) (step : t ⭢βᵛ t') : Typing Γ t' τ := by
  induction der generalizing t'
  case' app σ τ _ der _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    cases step
    case' abs =>
      have ⟨_, _, _, _⟩ := der.abs_inv (Sub.refl der.wf.1 der.wf.2.2)
  case' tapp Γ _ σ τ σ' der _ ih =>
    cases step
    case tabs =>
      have ⟨_, _, _, _⟩ := der.tabs_inv (Sub.refl der.wf.1 der.wf.2.2)
      have ⟨X, mem⟩ := fresh_exists $ free_union [Ty.fv, fvTy] Var
      simp at mem
      have : Γ = Context.mapVal (·[X := σ']) [] ++ Γ := rfl
      rw [openTy_substTy_intro (X := X), open_subst_intro (X := X)] <;> grind [subst_ty]
  case' let' L _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    cases step
    case let_bind red₁ _ => apply Typing.let' L $ ih₁ red₁; assumption
  case' case Γ _ σ τ _ _ _ L der _ _ ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
    have := List.nil_append Γ
    cases step
    case «case» red₁ _ _ => apply Typing.case L $ ih₁ red₁ <;> assumption
    case' case_inl =>
      have ⟨_, _⟩ := der.inl_inv (Sub.refl der.wf.1 der.wf.2.2)
    case' case_inr =>
      have ⟨_, _⟩ := der.inr_inv (Sub.refl der.wf.1 der.wf.2.2)
  case' app.abs | let' | case.case_inl | case.case_inr =>
    have ⟨x, hx⟩ := fresh_exists $ free_union [fvTm] Var
    simp at hx
    all_goals grind [openTm_substTm_intro (x := x), subst_tm, Sub.weaken]
  all_goals grind [cases Red]

name: Cslib.FLP.PseudoConsensus.of_consensus
proof:
theorem of_consensus [Fintype P] (f : ℕ) (hf : f < card P)
    (hc : a.Consensus f) : a.PseudoConsensus f := by
  refine ⟨hc.1, ?_⟩
  rintro inp s ⟨xl, hx⟩ ps hps
  let seg := a.fairSegActions (a.simpleDeliver ps) ps s
  let xs := xl ++ω seg.flatten
  have hd := simpleDeliver_fair (a := a) ps
  obtain ⟨ss, he, hs, _, _, _, fair⟩ := fair_omegaExecution hd s trivial
  obtain ⟨zz, hz, h0, _, ht⟩ := LTS.OmegaExecution.append hx he hs
  have dest := omega_forall_actions hd s trivial (simpleDeliver_forallActions ps) (by simp [DestIn])
  have keep : ∀ p ∈ ps, ProcFair p zz xs := by
    intro p hp
    apply (Algorithm.drop_procFair_iff hz p xl.length).mp
    simpa [xs, ht, drop_append_of_ge_length] using fair p hp
  have hb : numProcFaulty zz xs ≤ f := by
    have := numProcFaulty_le_not_procFair keep
    omega
  have adm : a.AdmissibleRun inp f zz xs := by
    refine ⟨h0, hz, ?_, hb⟩
    intro p
    by_cases hp : ProcFair p zz xs
    · exact Or.inr hp
    · apply Or.inl
      have np : p ∉ ps := mt (keep p) hp
      obtain ⟨m, hm, n, _, stay⟩ := Algorithm.not_fair_stay_enabled hz hp
      refine ⟨n + xl.length, ⟨m, (stay _ (by omega)).1, hm⟩, ?_⟩
      intro j hj m' hj'
      simp only [xs, get_append_right', show xl.length ≤ j by omega] at hj'
      have d := dest (j - xl.length)
      rw [hj'] at d
      rintro rfl
      exact np d
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := not_procFaulty_of_numProcFaulty (hb.trans_lt hf)
  obtain ⟨n, b, h⟩ := Or.resolve_left (hc.2 inp zz xs adm p) hp
  refine ⟨ss n, b, ⟨seg.flatten.extract 0 n, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hs] using he.extract_mTr (Nat.zero_le n)
  · simp [extract_eq_take, List.forall_iff_forall_mem, List.forall_mem_iff_getElem]
    grind
  · apply Algorithm.decided_stable (a := a) (show (zz n).Decided b from ⟨p, h⟩)
    use xs.extract n (n + xl.length)
    rw [← ht]
    exact hz.extract_mTr (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

name: Cslib.Automata.NA.Buchi.buchiFamily_saturation
proof:
theorem buchiFamily_saturation [Inhabited Symbol] :
    Saturates (fun i ↦ (na.buchiFamily i).toSet) (language na).toSet := by
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ ⟨xs, h_xs, ⟨ss, ⟨h_init, h_exec⟩, h_acc⟩⟩ ys h_ys
  obtain ⟨xl, xls, h_xl_c, h_xls_c, rfl⟩ := mem_buchiFamily.mp h_xs
  obtain ⟨yl, yls, h_yl_c, h_yls_c, rfl⟩ := mem_buchiFamily.mp h_ys
  let f k := xl.length + xls.cumLen k
  let ts := ωSequence.mk fun k ↦ ss (f k)
  have h_yl_e := LTS.Execution.to_mTr
    (buchiCongruence_transfer (s := ss 0) (t := ts 0) h_xl_c h_yl_c (by
      grind [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr h_exec (Nat.zero_le xl.length),
        extract_append_zero_right, LTS.mem_pairLang])).choose_spec.1
  clear h_xl_c h_yl_c
  simp only [Language.mem_sub_one] at h_xls_c h_yls_c
  have h_xls_p k := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (h_xls_c k).2
  have h_yls_p k := List.length_pos_iff.mpr (h_yls_c k).2
  choose sls h_yls_e h_yls_a using fun k ↦
    buchiCongruence_transfer (s := ts k) (t := ts (k + 1))
      (h_xls_c k).left (h_yls_c k).left (by
        clear h_xls_c h_yls_c h_init h_acc h_yls_p h_yl_e
        grind [LTS.OmegaExecution.extract_mTr h_exec (?_ : f k ≤ f (k + 1)),
          LTS.mem_pairLang, extract_append_right_right, add_tsub_cancel_left])
  obtain ⟨ss1, h_ss1_run, h_ss1_seg⟩ := LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_execution h_yls_e h_yls_p
  clear h_xls_c h_yls_c
  have h_start m : ss1 (yls.cumLen m) = ts m := by
    clear h_xls_p h_acc h_exec h_init h_yls_a h_ss1_run h_yl_e
    specialize h_yls_e m
    specialize h_ss1_seg m
    have h := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt (cumLen_strictMono h_yls_p (Nat.lt_succ_self m))
    clear h_yls_p
    have : 0 < (sls m).length := by grind
    have := h_yls_e.choose_spec.1
    grind [get_extract (xs := ss1) h]
  suffices ∃ᶠ k in atTop, ss1 k ∈ na.accept by
    obtain ⟨ss2, h2⟩ := LTS.OmegaExecution.append h_yl_e h_ss1_run (by simpa using h_start 0)
    use ss2
    have := @drop_frequently_iff_frequently _ ss2 na.accept yl.length
    clear h_xls_p h_yls_p h_yls_e h_yls_a h_ss1_seg h_exec h_acc h_start
    grind [Run.mk]
  apply frequently_atTop.mpr
  intro n
  obtain ⟨m, _, s, _, h_mem⟩ :=
    frequently_atTop.mp ((frequently_via_accept h_acc h_exec h_xls_p f rfl ts rfl).mono h_yls_a) n
  obtain ⟨k, _, _⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp h_mem
  use yls.cumLen m + k
  suffices ss1 (yls.cumLen m + k) = (sls m)[k] by
    have := StrictMono.add_le_nat (cumLen_strictMono h_yls_p) m 0
    lia
  clear h_xls_p h_acc h_exec h_init h_yls_a h_ss1_run h_yl_e
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _⟩ := h_yls_e m
  by_cases hk : k < (yls m).length
  · specialize h_ss1_seg m
    clear h_yls_p h_yls_e h_start
    have h : k < yls.cumLen (m + 1) - yls.cumLen m := by
      rwa [cumLen_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    grind [get_extract (xs := ss1) h]
  · have := h_start (m + 1)
    clear h_start h_yls_p h_yls_e h_ss1_seg
    grind

name: Cslib.FLP.OnePseudoConsensus.nonUniform_step
proof:
theorem nonUniform_step [Fintype P] (hpc1 : a.PseudoConsensus 1)
    {s : State P M S} (hr : a.Reachable inp s) (hn : a.NonUniform s) (p : P) :
    ∃ s', a.lts.CanReach s s' ∧ ∀ b, a.CanDecideWithout s' p b := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := canDecideWithout_exists hpc1 hr p
  obtain ⟨q, t, ⟨xs, hxs, -⟩, hd⟩ := hn !b
  clear hn
  induction xs generalizing s
  all_goals
    by_cases hnb : a.CanDecideWithout s p !b
    · use s, ⟨[], .refl⟩
      intro c
      cases b <;> cases c <;> assumption
  · cases hxs
    exfalso
    simpa using decided_eq_canDecideWithout hpc1 hr hd hb
  rename_i x xs ih
  cases hxs
  rename_i hu hus
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨ys, hy⟩, hv⟩ :=
    ih (Algorithm.reachable_stable hr ⟨[x], .single _ hu⟩)
      (by
        cases x
        cases Algorithm.tr_none hu
        assumption
        exact canDecideWithout_uniform hpc1 hr hu hb hnb) hus
  use v, ⟨x :: ys, .stepL hu hy⟩, hv

name: Cslib.LTS.OmegaExecution.flatten_execution
proof:
theorem OmegaExecution.flatten_execution [Inhabited Label]
    {ts : ωSequence State} {μls : ωSequence (List Label)} {sls : ωSequence (List State)}
    (hexec : ∀ k, lts.Execution (ts k) (μls k) (ts (k + 1)) (sls k))
    (hpos : ∀ k, (μls k).length > 0) :
    ∃ ss, lts.OmegaExecution ss μls.flatten ∧
      ∀ k, ss.extract (μls.cumLen k) (μls.cumLen (k + 1)) = (sls k).take (μls k).length := by
  have : Inhabited State := ⟨ts 0⟩
  let segs := ωSequence.mk fun k ↦ (sls k).take (μls k).length
  have h_len : μls.cumLen = segs.cumLen := by ext k; induction k <;> grind
  have h_pos k : (segs k).length > 0 := by
    specialize hexec k
    grind
  have h_mono := cumLen_strictMono h_pos
  have h_seg0 k : (segs k)[0]! = ts k := by
    specialize hexec k
    grind
  use segs.flatten
  constructor
  · intro n
    simp only [h_len, flatten_def]
    specialize hexec (segment segs.cumLen n)
    have := segment_lower_bound h_mono cumLen_zero n
    clear h_pos
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le (Nat.add_one_le_iff.mpr (segment_upper_bound h_mono cumLen_zero n)) with h_n | h1
    · have := segment_range_val h_mono (by omega) h_n
      clear h_seg0
      grind
    · have : n + 1 - segs.cumLen (segment segs.cumLen n) = (μls (segment segs.cumLen n)).length := by
        rw [h1, ← h_len, cumLen_succ, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      simp only [h1, segment_idem h_mono, Nat.sub_self, h_seg0]
      clear h_seg0
      grind
  · simp [h_len, extract_flatten h_pos, segs]

name: Cslib.FLP.CanReachVia.subset_inp
proof:
theorem subset_inp [Fintype P] {ps : Set P} {inp1 inp2 : P → Bool} {s1 : State P M S}
    (he : InpEqOn ps inp1 inp2) (hr : a.CanReachVia ps (a.start inp1) s1) :
    ∃ s2, a.CanReachVia ps (a.start inp2) s2 ∧ s2.proc = s1.proc := by
  suffices sim : ∀ {s u xs}, a.lts.MTr s xs u →
      ∀ t, State.proc t = s.proc →
      (∀ m, m.dest ∈ ps → t.msgs.count m = s.msgs.count m) →
      xs.Forall (DestIn ps) →
      ∃ v, a.CanReachVia ps t v ∧ v.proc = u.proc by
    obtain ⟨xs, h, hx⟩ := hr
    refine sim h _ rfl ?_ hx
    intro m hm
    simp only [Algorithm.start, count_map]
    congr
    grind only [InpEqOn]
  intro s u xs h
  induction h <;> intro t hp hm hx
  next =>
    exact ⟨t, refl ps t, hp⟩
  next s x u xs v ht h ih =>
    rw [List.forall_cons] at hx
    obtain ⟨hx, hxs⟩ := hx
    cases x with
    | none =>
      cases ht
      exact ih t hp hm hxs
    | some m =>
      obtain ⟨hmem, rfl⟩ := ht
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hwp⟩ := ih (a.recvMsg m t)
        (by simp only [Algorithm.recvMsg, hp])
        (by
          intro n hn
          rcases eq_or_ne n m with rfl | hnm <;>
            simp [Algorithm.recvMsg, count_erase_of_ne, *]) hxs
      exact ⟨w, stepL hx ⟨by
        rwa [← one_le_count_iff_mem, hm m hx, one_le_count_iff_mem], rfl⟩ hw, hwp⟩

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Untyped.Term.parallel_diamond
proof:
theorem parallel_diamond : Diamond ((· ⭢ₚ ·) : Term Var → Term Var → Prop) := by
  have join {m l r : Term Var} {xs ys : Finset Var}
      (ih : ∀ x ∉ xs, ∀ {v}, (m ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ v →
        ∃ w, (l ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ w ∧ v ⭢ₚ w)
      (hr : ∀ x ∉ ys, (m ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ r ^ fvar x) :
      ∃ w, abs l ⭢ₚ w ∧ abs r ⭢ₚ w := by
    have ⟨x, qx⟩ := fresh_exists $ xs ∪ ys ∪ fv l ∪ fv r
    simp only [Finset.mem_union, not_or] at qx
    have ⟨w, hw⟩ := ih x qx.1.1.1 (hr x qx.1.1.2)
    suffices ∀ {v}, x ∉ fv v → (v ^ fvar x) ⭢ₚ w →
        abs v ⭢ₚ abs (w ^* x) from
      ⟨_, this qx.1.2 hw.1, this qx.2 hw.2⟩
    intro v hv h
    apply Parallel.abs ∅
    intros
    rw [open_close_var x v hv]
    exact para_open_close _ _ _ h
  intros t t1 t2 tpt1
  induction tpt1 generalizing t2 <;> intro tpt2
  case fvar =>
    cases tpt2
    exact ⟨_, .fvar _, .fvar _⟩
  case abs =>
    cases tpt2
    apply join <;> assumption
  case beta =>
    rename_i ih1 ih2
    cases tpt2
    case' app =>
      rename_i s1pu2 s2pu2'
      cases s1pu2
      rename_i mem'
    case' beta =>
      rename_i mem' s2pu2'
    all_goals
      obtain ⟨w, hl, hr⟩ := join ih1 mem'
      obtain ⟨v, hv1, hv2⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
      cases hl
      cases hr
      rename_i ys hys zs hzs
      exact ⟨_, para_open_out ys hys hv1, by
        first
        | exact Parallel.beta zs hzs hv2
        | exact para_open_out zs hzs hv2⟩
  case app =>
    rename_i s1ps1' _ ih1 ih2
    cases tpt2
    case app =>
      rename_i s1 s2
      obtain ⟨l, hl, hl'⟩ := ih1 s1
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hr'⟩ := ih2 s2
      exact ⟨_, Parallel.app hl hr, Parallel.app hl' hr'⟩
    case beta =>
      rename_i xs mem s2pu2'
      cases s1ps1'
      obtain ⟨t', qt'_l, qt'_r⟩ := ih2 s2pu2'
      obtain ⟨t'', qt''_l, qt''_r⟩ := ih1 (Parallel.abs xs mem)
      cases qt''_l
      cases qt''_r
      rename_i xs'' mem'' xs''' mem'''
      exact ⟨_, Parallel.beta xs'' mem'' qt'_l,
        para_open_out xs''' mem''' qt'_r⟩
